curated.tagline: Browser-to-sandbox pipeline that turns live SaaS pricing pages into CSV and JSON
curated.description: A Solari demo built for a SWE intern application. One cloud browser loads each configured pricing page, a headless sandbox parses it with a shared parser in two modes (class-based for React pricing cards, heading-based heuristic for conventional pages), and the host merges the per-site output into one CSV and one JSON. The parser is unit-tested against sample HTML without an API key.
highlights: Multi-URL pipeline from cloud browser to isolated sandbox
Two parsing modes for different pricing-page layouts
Combined pricing.csv and pricing.json from a verified live run
Runs inside the Solari Free plan: one browser, one sandbox, released on exit
curated.architecture: sites.json → cloud browser → HTML upload → sandbox parser → per-site output → merged CSV and JSON
